literal_meaning: খবর রাখা বা সতর্কতা (news keeping or alertness)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চাদের খবরদারি করো, তারা বিপদে পড়তে পারে।
example_sentences_in_english: Keep a watch on the children; they might get into trouble.
It's essential to maintain vigilance over the house.
note: Derived from Persian influence in Bengali vocabulary, commonly used in everyday supervision contexts.
